vehicle: 2007 Yamaha V Star 650 (XVS650 Custom / XVS650A Classic / XVS650AT Silverado; variant unconfirmed), 649cc air-cooled V-twin, dual Mikuni carbs, wet clutch, shaft drive
scope_note: Reduced scope (demo/test vehicle): 8 parts, 3 guides, 3 tools. Many prices not checked; RevZilla, manualowl, AMSOIL and Yamaha EU manual PDFs returned 403 to automated fetch and were skipped.

parts.name: Engine oil
parts.spec: 4-stroke motorcycle oil, JASO MA/MA2 (wet clutch), API SG or higher; Yamalube 10W-40 / 20W-40 typical (Yamaha chart: 20W-40 above ~32F, 10W-30 below; verify chart in your manual). 2.80 L (2.96 US qt) with filter; 2.60 L (2.75 US qt) oil only
parts.notes: Engine, gearbox and wet clutch share the oil. Do NOT use 'Energy Conserving'/'Resource Conserving' car oil: friction modifiers can make the clutch slip. Capacities are from the 2011 V Star 650 Custom owner's manual (search snippet); same engine as 2007 but confirm in your manual.

parts.name: Oil filter (cartridge element)
parts.spec: Paper cartridge element under a cover on the engine (not spin-on)

part_numbers.number: verify: 4X7-13440-xx family per HF145 cross-refs; RevZilla lists 5GH-13440-71-00 (supersedes 5GH-13440-00-00) but fitment to XVS650 not confirmed

parts.notes: HF145/KN-145 is the consistent aftermarket fit for 1998-2016 XVS650. Look up the OEM number on a Partzilla/Yamaha fiche with your VIN before ordering OEM. Replace the cover O-rings if supplied/hardened.

parts.name: Spark plugs (2)
parts.spec: NGK DPR7EA-9, gap ~0.8-0.9 mm (0.031-0.035 in; listing value 0.035 in, verify against manual)

part_numbers.number: verify (X22EPR-U9 is the usual cross; not confirmed for this bike)

parts.notes: Two plugs (one per cylinder). Some retailer pages list wrong plugs (BR10EG, RA8HC) for this bike; ignore those.

parts.name: Battery
parts.spec: YT12B-BS size (12 V, sealed AGM) per Yuasa/retailer fitment; NOT YTX14-BS (no source ties YTX14 to the XVS650). Verify against the battery in the bike.
parts.notes: Read the label on the installed battery before buying. Lithium (Shorai/Antigravity) options exist in this size but not researched (scope cut).

parts.notes: K&N fitment years vary by seller (Happy-Trail: Custom/Classic 1998-2016, Silverado 2002-2011). A K&N alone shouldn't need rejetting, but a pod filter/open exhaust will.

guides.title: Engine oil and filter change
tools: 5 mm and 4 mm Allen (filter cover; per video)
steps: Warm engine a few minutes, then shut off; bike upright on level ground (Yamaha checks level upright, not on sidestand)
Remove oil filter cover, replace cartridge (HF145/KN-145), check cover O-ring(s)
Reinstall drain bolt with new crush washer; torque to manual spec (verify)
Fill ~2.8 L (2.96 US qt) JASO MA oil, start, idle briefly, check for leaks
Shut off, wait a few minutes, check sight glass/level upright; top up between marks
safety: Don't overtighten drain bolt into aluminum case
Never use energy-conserving car oil (clutch slip)

guides.title: Final gear (shaft drive) oil change
tools: socket/wrench for filler and drain plugs (size verify)
steps: Ride briefly to warm the oil
Bike upright; remove filler plug first (so you know you can refill), then drain plug
Inspect drained oil and the magnetic drain plug for metal flakes
Reinstall drain plug with new gasket
Fill ~0.19 L SAE 80 GL-4 hypoid oil until level reaches bottom of filler threads (verify level spec)
Reinstall filler plug with new gasket; check for leaks
safety: Gear oil smells strongly; wear gloves

guides.title: Carburetor sync (balance)
tools: Carb sync tool (Morgan Carbtune, Motion Pro SyncPro, or dual vacuum gauges)
fan (air-cooled bike idling a long time)
steps: Remove vacuum caps/hoses from each intake and connect the gauges (one to the petcock vacuum line's port may need a tee; keep petcock fed or set to PRI if equipped)
Set idle to spec with the idle screw (verify spec, ~1,200 rpm typical)
Turn the synchronizing screw between the carbs until both readings match
safety: Don't let the engine idle for long without airflow (air-cooled)
Keep hands clear of hot exhaust

tools.name: Carb sync tool
tools.example: Morgan Carbtune Pro (mercury-free, 2-4 cyl) or Motion Pro SyncPro; DIY clear-hose manometer works too
tools.notes: Price not checked (scope cut); verify at RevZilla/Amazon.

tools.name: Valve adjust tools
tools.use_for: Screw-and-locknut valve clearance (intake 0.004 in / 0.10 mm, exhaust 0.006 in / 0.15 mm per Technocoma; verify)
tools.example: Motion Pro tappet adjuster tool + metric feeler gauges; torque wrench (in-lb)
tools.notes: Locknut ~10 ft-lb, tappet covers ~7 ft-lb per Technocoma; verify in service manual.

tools.name: Battery maintainer
tools.use_for: Winter storage / keeping AGM battery topped
tools.example: Battery Tender Jr (0.75 A) or NOCO Genius 1/2, with pigtail lead left on the battery
tools.notes: Prices not checked (scope cut). If you go lithium, use a maintainer with a lithium mode.

additives.product: Fuel stabilizer (Sta-Bil or Yamaha Stabilizer/Star Tronic)
additives.why: Carb bowls varnish fast on ethanol fuel; stabilize and run through the carbs, or drain the float bowls

additives.product: Yamaha Ring Free / Fuel Medic, Seafoam
additives.why: Can help mild varnish; won't clear a plugged pilot jet (that needs a carb clean)
Shared wet-clutch oil; friction modifiers can cause clutch slip
